description: A fixed-layout Macaron card that embeds RollPicker and a submit button. The button label switches between "🎲 Spin" and "Get picks".

columns.description: Column data for the embedded roll picker. Supports 1 to 3 columns at runtime; extra columns are ignored.

title.description: Column title shown in default state.

selection.description: Display values of each column, one entry per rendered column.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

action.description: Action dispatched when the bottom button is tapped. Runtime injects selectedValues, selectedIndexes, and hasCustomSelection.

context.description: A list of name-value pairs to be sent with the action to include data associated with the action, e.g. values that are submitted.

path.description: A path in the data model which should be bound to an input element, e.g. a string reference for a text field, or number reference for a slider.

literalString.description: A literal string relevant to the action

literalNumber.description: A literal number relevant to the action

literalBoolean.description: A literal boolean relevant to the action

hasCustomSelection.description: Optional boolean reference. True when at least one column is not on default title.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

title: RollPickerCard
